name: Pattern Practice
summary: A card-based learning identity that invites short experiments with a rule, a response and a simple way to compare attempts.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Practice teal
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/styles.xml: style CardPattern, style CardLabel; text.

typography.usage: Native Title and Heading1 plus CardNumber use Chalkboard for activity titles and large card numbers.
Normal, CardBody and supporting labels use Trebuchet MS for instructions and materials.

recognitionRules: Use Chalkboard activity titles and large card numbers, with Trebuchet instructions and teal practice labels.
Give each card one activity with materials and an action prompt.
Use symbols only when accompanied by a readable label.
Keep enough open space for a learner’s own pattern or explanation.
Use teal activity labels and pattern symbols; retain handwritten Chalkboard titles above practical Trebuchet instructions.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Find the rule. Try it another way. Tell someone what you noticed.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use PATTERN PRACTICE in Trebuchet with a three-unit repeating mark whose last unit is open. Avoid a puzzle-piece symbol.
invariants: Use Chalkboard activity titles and large card numbers, with Trebuchet instructions and teal practice labels.
Give each card one activity with materials and an action prompt.
Use symbols only when accompanied by a readable label.
adaptations: Large-format cards support group use; small cards retain the same reading order.
New activities may change the pattern while keeping the prompt structure.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Chalkboard is an Apple/system font; not bundled.
Trebuchet MS is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
